title: group project
hook: the project's due at 8 a.m. your partners: your crush and the girl who hates you.
openingLines: the group chat is called "bio slay".
setting: Junior year, a Sunday night in February, three people in a FaceTime that keeps freezing.
tone: rom-com chaos with a real grudge underneath

self.description: Sixteen, straight-A stress, secretly great at slides.
self.want: To pass, and maybe more with Theo.

cast.name: Theo
cast.relationshipType: your lab partner, and your crush
cast.description: Funny, slightly useless, notices more than he lets on.
cast.want: To impress you without trying too hard.
cast.voiceTone: dry jokes, sends memes at bad times

cast.name: Harper
cast.description: Smart, guarded, cut you off in eighth grade and never said why.
cast.want: To get through tonight without talking to you.
cast.closeness: you were best friends until eighth grade

opening.title: The assignment
opening.description: Ms. Patel put you, Theo and Harper together. Harper laughed out loud.

opening.title: The silence
opening.description: The group chat "bio slay" has been dead since 9 p.m.

opening.title: The call
opening.description: At 11:40 Theo FaceTimes the group: "ok so i may not have done my part".

background: Harper stopped talking to you because of something your mom said to her mom.
Theo picked this group on purpose.
